title: 义务教育教科书·英语（辽师大）六年级上册

units.title: Unit 7
units.themeEn: What are you going to do?

sentences.cn: 他说我不能看太多电视。
sentences.en: He says I can’t watch TV too much.

sentences.cn: 这是谁的雨伞？也许是你的。
sentences.en: Whose umbrella is this? Maybe it is yours.

sentences.cn: 带上你的雨衣和这张贺卡。
sentences.en: Take your raincoat and this card.

sentences.cn: 我的凉鞋、拖鞋和运动鞋都在这里。
sentences.en: My sandals, slippers and sneakers are here.
My glasses are on the desk.

sentences.cn: 我最喜欢的明星是马龙。
sentences.en: My favorite star is Ma Long.

sentences.cn: 这是我的好朋友约翰尼。
sentences.en: This is my good friend, Johnny.
My e-pal lives in New Zealand.

sentences.cn: 那只鸟能飞得又高又快。
sentences.en: The bird can fly high and fast.

sentences.cn: 雪莉在给朱迪发一些家庭照片。
sentences.en: Shelley is sending some family photos to Judy.
Li Wei’s father is a teacher.

sentences.cn: 李伟为爸爸感到非常自豪。
sentences.en: Li Wei is very proud of his father.
What does Li Wei’s father teach?

sentences.cn: 李伟的爸爸周末做什么？
sentences.en: What does Li Wei’s father do on weekends?
My hobby is to collect stamps.

sentences.cn: 埃米莉通常和朋友们做什么？
sentences.en: What does Emily usually do with her friends?

sentences.cn: 埃米莉为什么这么受欢迎？

sentences.en: The editor works at the TV station.
I write an article at night.

sentences.cn: 雪莉和朱迪在网上聊天。
sentences.en: Shelley and Judy are chatting on the Internet.
She and I have the same interests.

sentences.cn: 这是我的好朋友长颈鹿。
sentences.en: This is my good friend, Giraffe.
We have a picnic in the park.

sentences.cn: 我给朋友发一封电子邮件。
sentences.en: I send an email to my friend.
He likes to surf the Internet.

sentences.cn: 李明和朋友们在教室里谈话。
sentences.en: Li Ming and his friends are talking in the classroom.

sentences.cn: 李明，你想和我们一起去吗？
sentences.en: Do you want to go with us, Li Ming?
I’m going to climb Mount Tai.

sentences.cn: 我们今天去看望祖父母吧。

sentences.en: I want to read a storybook.
We plant vegetables on the farm.
How can I get to the art museum?

sentences.cn: 我要从大连到海南，好好玩一趟。
sentences.en: I’m going to have a happy journey from Dalian to Hainan.
How does Ann go to school every day?
I will go to Happy Island.
I will not stop until I get there.

sentences.cn: 我怎样才能去主题公园？
sentences.en: How can I go to the theme park?
How can I go to the hospital?
How can I go to the restaurant?
How can I go to the bookstore?
But how can I get there?

sentences.cn: 琳达怎样才能到博物馆？
sentences.en: How can Linda get to the museum?
Which bus goes to the park?
I am afraid I cannot go.

sentences.cn: 我们坐火车去北京，坐飞机回来。
sentences.en: We go to Beijing by train, and we come back by plane.
Jim is going to King’s College.

sentences.cn: 爸爸，我怎样才能看懂地图？
sentences.en: Dad, how can I read the map?

sentences.cn: 午饭后，大卫在教室里和小惠谈话。
sentences.en: After lunch, David is talking with Xiao Hui in the classroom.

sentences.cn: 小猪的生日是什么时候？

sentences.en: Turn right at the second corner.
The bank is next to the shop.
Turn left and the park is near.

sentences.cn: 我可以把座位让给你吗？
sentences.en: May I Offer You My Seat?

sentences.cn: 安妮的生日是什么时候？

sentences.en: We light the candle and make a wish.
David, I’m going to buy some flower seeds.
Wang Qiang is going to the nature park.

sentences.cn: 朱莉娅要回澳大利亚了。
sentences.en: Julia is going back to Australia.
There are twelve months in a year.

sentences.cn: 八月和九月是很热的月份。
sentences.en: August and September are hot months.

sentences.cn: 我们参观紫禁城和颐和园。
sentences.en: We visit the Forbidden City and the Summer Palace.
